name: Greenhouse Banana Couture
image_purpose: surreal fashion editorial and gallery print

prompt.project_info: Create a cinematic medium portrait through condensation-covered greenhouse glass with a practical banana-and-leaf couture sculpture.
prompt.main_subject: A clearly adult fictional woman with natural pores, soft downward gaze, contained bob or pulled-back hair, and a fully covered voluminous architectural gown built from cascading yellow banana peels and waxy green leaves, with opaque underlayer and hands safely concealed in the garment layers.
prompt.composition_elements: 16:9 eye-level portrait through dirty greenhouse glass, rule-of-thirds placement, layered foreground obstruction, cluttered botanist workshop with books, amber jars, hoses, tools, and dust.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm directional sunlight on organic dress texture, deep cinematic teal shadows, humid dusty air, practical-effects realism, no neon.
prompt.technical_specs: Hasselblad H6D-100c, 80mm f/1.9, microscopic fruit-skin detail, atmospheric dust motes, Kodak Portra 400 fine grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Hyper-realistic 16:9 cinematic editorial portrait through condensation-covered greenhouse glass of a clearly adult fictional woman in a fully covered voluminous architectural gown made from cascading yellow banana peels and waxy green leaves, opaque underlayer, soft downward gaze, cluttered botanist workshop with amber jars, books, hoses, tools, warm sunlight, deep teal shadows, tactile practical-effects realism, Hasselblad H6D-100c 80mm f/1.9, Kodak Portra 400, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, transparent clothing, sexualized pose, unsafe organic material, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, gore, mold, plastic skin, CGI, watermark, logo, text, neon
